method: OpenCascade Boolean intersection of the moving camera rear/front cases (COMPOUND solids 0 and 8) with yaw-frame solid 5. Yaw=0; the result is yaw-invariant because both stages share yaw motion.
limitation: Selected pair and poses only; no complete robot self-collision or cable check. Independent +/-90 degree bounds do not enforce a collision-free coupled workspace.
finding: Pitch +90 degrees with roll +/-90 degrees intersects the rear yaw support. Coupled motion constraints or a bracket revision are required before full-range head tracking.
